thread:
Emma (Head of Product): quick live Q&A beat: collecting the most actionable why-we-won / why-we-lost signals from the field and the concrete asks we should surface to leadership. i'll keep this tight so we can convert to tickets.
Priya (Sales): pipeline color: wins = reliable p95 during pilots + clear onboarding checklist. losses = data residency requests + lack of a simple billing cap. two prospects stalled over unknown month-end bills.
Jesse (SRE): ops note: a repeated loss mode is surprise throttling when a tenant's burst pattern hits autoscale limits. customers want predictable hard caps or graceful degradation.
Sophia (CS): concrete example: BrightMed paused because we couldn't promise EU data residency for logs; they needed logs never to leave region.
Ben (Customer Success): top asks across pilots: 1) a "billing cap" option to cap monthly spend, 2) a documented regional data-residency beta, 3) a small regression kit (seed prompts + eval harness), 4) a canary/rollback guarantee for model updates.
Lin (Eng PM): engineering triage: short-term: billing cap as a UI toggle + webhook for alerts (1 sprint), small regression kit in CI for pinned customers (2 sprints). medium: data-residency beta (3-6 sprints; infra + compliance). long: contractual model-update rollback SLA (depends on infra work).
David (CEO): good. prioritize the items that unblock committed deals first (billing cap, data-residency beta). can we get a 1-page plan with owners by next Tue?
Emma (Head of Product): yes. proposed owners: Lin = billing cap plan, Jesse = graceful-degrade patterns + webhook, Ben + Priya = customer language for contracts, Sophia = regression kit spec.
Priya (Sales): small ask: for the billing cap, please include an option to auto-notify and to route excess requests to a cheaper hosted fallback model. customers want continuity.
Jesse (SRE): we can implement a two-tier flow: when spend >= cap_threshold, 1) block high-cost routes, 2) route to hosted-fallback and emit webhook. estimate: 1 sprint for MVP.
Sophia (CS): about the regression kit  can we include a "golden prompt set" where customers can upload 20 critical prompts and we run them on each deploy and alert on regressions? that's what wins trust.
Lin (Eng PM): yes  propose: customer-golden-set + deploy-sample-run with a configurable threshold to fail canary. need product + eng to agree on UX. est: 2 sprints.
Ben (Customer Success): i'll collect wording from three prospects for the one-pager so legal can slot it into an SLA appendix. include exact phrasing customers use for "billing cap" and "data residency".
David (CEO): finance note: we'll model the revenue impact of billing caps; ok to proceed with an MVP but need pricing guardrails. Tom (Finance) will run numbers after we have p95 targets.
Emma (Head of Product): question for leadership: any preference on the data-residency beta scope? minimal useful scope = logs + metric retention in region + no outbound log exports by default.
David (CEO): that minimal scope seems fine for beta. security/legal must signoff. Omar (Security)  please advise on minimal controls.
Jesse (SRE): technical caveat: region-locked logs need changes to our logging pipeline + retention config. we can expose this as a tenant flag with a beta label. influence on cost = moderate.
Priya (Sales): quick win request: can we get a short FAQ about batching/quantization + accuracy examples so sales can set expectations in pilots? not a deep paper, one page with numbers.
Sophia (CS): i can draft the FAQ with a small table: config -> expected token-cost change -> common accuracy delta. include 2-3 concrete examples.
Ben (Customer Success): action: i'll convene a 30-min customer panel this week with two prospects who asked for billing caps to validate the proposed webhook behavior.
allhands-bot: :spiral_calendar: task created: "billing-cap MVP plan" owner: Lin, due: 7 days; task created: "data-residency beta spec" owner: Jesse, due: 14 days; task created: "regression-kit spec" owner: Sophia, due: 10 days.
David (CEO): please keep the one-pagers concrete (scope, owner, minimal acceptance criteria, risks). leadership will review them next Wed.
Emma (Head of Product): will post the drafts here and convert to tickets. please keep follow-ups short so i can synthesize. thanks all. :thumbsup:
